mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_score_record (defense_id, question_id, round_num, expression_score, logic_score, professional_score, adaptability_score, innovation_score, comment, created_at) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{questionId}, #{roundNum}, #{expressionScore}, #{logicScore}, #{professionalScore}, #{adaptabilityScore}, #{innovationScore}, #{comment}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, defense_id, question_id, round_num, expression_score, logic_score, professional_score, adaptability_score, innovation_score, comment, created_at FROM defense_score_record WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} ORDER BY round_num ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rounds, ROUND(AVG(expression_score), 1) AS avg_expression, ROUND(AVG(logic_score), 1) AS avg_logic, ROUND(AVG(professional_score), 1) AS avg_professional, ROUND(AVG(adaptability_score), 1) AS avg_adaptability, ROUND(AVG(innovation_score), 1) AS avg_innovation, ROUND(AVG(expression_score + logic_score + professional_score + adaptability_score + innovation_score) / 5, 1) AS avg_total, ROUND(SUM(expression_score + logic_score + professional_score + adaptability_score + innovation_score) / 5, 1) AS sum_total FROM defense_score_record WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId}
